mapper.update: UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_generation SET build_fence_source_id=#{nextFenceSourceId},expected_source_count=#{nextSourceCount}, content_checksum=NULL,verified_member_checksum=NULL,verified_mutation_epoch=NULL, analysis_projection_version=0,verified_analysis_checksum=NULL, verified_analysis_identity_checksum=NULL,projected_analysis_identity_count=0, verified_at=NULL,completed_at=NULL WHERE id=#{generationId} AND generation_status='BUILDING' AND build_fence_source_id=#{expectedFenceSourceId} AND expected_source_count=#{expectedSourceCount} AND (build_cursor_source_id=build_fence_source_id OR (build_cursor_source_id IS NULL AND build_fence_source_id=0))

UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_generation SET build_cursor_source_id=#{cursorSourceId}, projected_source_count=projected_source_count+#{projectedDelta}, rejected_source_count=rejected_source_count+#{rejectedDelta} WHERE id=#{generationId} AND generation_status='BUILDING'

UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_generation SET projected_source_count=#{projectedCount},rejected_source_count=#{rejectedCount}, content_checksum=#{contentChecksum},verified_member_checksum=#{memberChecksum}, analysis_projection_version=#{analysisProjectionVersion}, verified_analysis_checksum=#{analysisChecksum}, verified_analysis_identity_checksum=#{analysisIdentityChecksum}, projected_analysis_identity_count=#{analysisIdentityCount}, verified_mutation_epoch=#{expectedEpoch},verified_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{generationId} AND generation_status='BUILDING' AND (build_cursor_source_id=build_fence_source_id OR (build_cursor_source_id IS NULL AND build_fence_source_id=0))

UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_generation SET build_fence_source_id=#{fenceSourceId},build_cursor_source_id=#{fenceSourceId}, expected_source_count=#{baselineCount},projected_source_count=#{projectedCount}, rejected_source_count=#{rejectedCount},content_checksum=#{contentChecksum}, verified_member_checksum=#{memberChecksum},verified_mutation_epoch=#{expectedEpoch}, analysis_projection_version=#{analysisProjectionVersion}, verified_analysis_checksum=#{analysisChecksum}, verified_analysis_identity_checksum=#{analysisIdentityChecksum}, projected_analysis_identity_count=#{analysisIdentityCount}, verified_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{generationId} AND generation_status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE t_phase_one_feedback_list_projection_generation SET generation_status=#{nextStatus}, activated_by=CASE WHEN #{nextStatus}='ACTIVE' THEN #{actorId} ELSE activated_by END, activated_at=CASE WHEN #{nextStatus}='ACTIVE' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE activated_at END, cutover_mutation_epoch=COALESCE(#{cutoverEpoch},cutover_mutation_epoch), failure_code=#{failureCode},failure_summary=#{failureSummary}, completed_at=CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} IN ('FAILED','RETIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE completed_at END WHERE id=#{generationId} AND generation_status=#{expectedStatus}
